test_snap_down: test the snap_down utility to snap a cube object onto a stage or support object surface
test_bb_ray_prescreen: test the bb_ray_prescreen utility to pre-screen bounding box raycast results for snap points
test_object_getters: test get_all_objects, get_all_object_ids, and get_ao_link_id_map to retrieve all objects and link mappings from the simulator
test_get_obj_from_id_and_handle: test get_obj_from_id and get_obj_from_handle to retrieve simulator objects by their integer id or template handle string
test_above_preposition: test the above utility to find all objects spatially above a given object using keypoint raycasting
test_within_preposition: test the within utility to find container objects that contain a given object based on keypoint vote threshold
test_object_keypoint_cast: test object_keypoint_cast to raycast from an object keypoints in a specified direction and collect hit results
test_object_in_region: test object_in_region and get_object_regions to check if an object is contained within a semantic scene region
test_ao_link_open_close: test link_is_open, link_is_closed, open_link, and close_link to query and toggle articulated object link states
test_link_joint_position: test get_link_normalized_joint_position and set_link_normalized_joint_position to read and write normalized joint positions on articulated links
test_get_ao_default_link: test get_ao_default_link to retrieve or compute the default link index for an articulated object
test_ontop_utility: test the ontop utility to find all object ids resting on top of a given object or articulated link
test_on_floor: test the on_floor utility to check whether a rigid object is resting directly on the floor
test_size_regularized_distance: test size_regularized_object_distance to compute a size-normalized distance metric between two objects in the simulator
test_obj_next_to: test obj_next_to to determine whether two objects are spatially adjacent to each other using bounding box heuristics
